scenario_name: Graphics Pipeline with DB and PDB Resolution (GlobalID=3553)
description: A compute shader dispatch scenario with multiple constant buffers, shader resource views (textures and buffers), unordered access views, and a static sampler. Based on GlobalID=3553 resource bindings.

test_cases.description: Retrieve all bound resources for a compute dispatch event (GlobalID=3553). Expects CBV, SRV Texture, SRV Buffer, UAV Buffer, and Sampler.
assertions: one resource has display_name == 'SRV Texture 0 : HZBTexture'
one resource has display_name == 'SRV Buffer 1 : LightViewSpacePositionAndRadius'
one resource has display_name == 'SRV Buffer 2 : LightViewSpaceDirAndPreprocAngle'
one resource has display_name == 'SRV Buffer 3 : LightViewSpaceRectPlanes'
one resource has display_name == 'SRV Buffer 4 : LightViewSpaceClipBoxData'
one resource has display_name == 'SRV Buffer 5 : IndirectionIndices'
one resource has display_name == 'UAV Buffer 0 : RWNumCulledLightsGrid'
one resource has display_name == 'UAV Buffer 1 : RWCulledLightDataGrid16Bit'
one resource has display_name == 'UAV Buffer 2 : RWCulledLightDataAllocator'
one resource has display_name == 'UAV Buffer 3 : RWCulledLightLinkAllocator'
one resource has display_name == 'UAV Buffer 4 : RWCulledLightLinks'
one resource has display_name == 'Static Sampler [1, space=1000] : D3DStaticPointClampedSampler'
